info.title: SYNTHORA Counterparty Business-Risk Verdict
info.description: Counterparty Business-Risk Verdict (composite): given a counterparty wallet and/or a token/pool contract, deterministically fuses OFAC/EU sanctions screening, on-chain wallet reputation and token-contract risk into a single weighted risk_score (0-100), a kill/pivot/proceed verdict, and reason_codes naming which sub-signal drove it — plus the raw sub-results. Sanctions weight 0.50, wallet 0.30, token 0.20, renormalised when a leg is unavailable; a sanctions hit forces a hard KILL. One counterparty check instead of three. Deterministic, no LLM, Ed25519-signed. $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. SYNTHORA.
x-use-cases: screen a counterparty wallet before transacting or onboarding
get one risk verdict for a wallet + token instead of three separate checks
block sanctioned or blacklisted counterparties automatically
score a new vendor/customer wallet for AML + reputation + token risk
gate an autonomous agent's payments on a kill/pivot/proceed decision
